name: Shael'dryn
summary: Shael'dryn is an inquisitive dryad residing beside the Moonwell of Purity, east of Iris Lake in Ashenvale. Known for her lighthearted wit and fondness for wordplay, she serves as a vital contact for night elf scouts investigating forest corruption. She plays a pivotal role in aiding Astranaar's sentinels with cleansing relics to combat demonic and foul influences spreading across the wilderness.

sections.title: A Jester of the Woods
sections.body: Daughter of Cenarius like all dryads, Shael'dryn approaches the perils of the wild with an unexpectedly playful spirit. Companions and travelers know her as a lover of puns and spoken jests, often using lighthearted humor to cut through the brooding tension of the tainted woodland. Yet behind her teasing demeanor lies deep devotion to the well-being of Ashenvale and its ancient spirits.

sections.title: Guardian of the Moonwell
sections.body: Stationed beside the Moonwell of Purity, Shael'dryn keeps watch alongside the night elf sentinels guarding the eastern approaches of the forest. When corruption surfaces among the local wildlife or tainted relics threaten the land's harmony, her deep natural understanding allows her to guide adventurers through the steps required to restore spiritual balance.

sections.title: Purification of the Woods
sections.body: Shael'dryn works closely in coordination with Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. When sentinels recover tainted artifacts such as corrupted glowing gems and the lost pieces of Dartol's Rod, Shael'dryn knows the obscure rituals, moonwell waters, and natural tokens needed to purify them, transforming dark curiosities into potent cleansing tools for the Alliance.

faq.answer: Shael'dryn is a dryad found beside the Moonwell of Purity in Ashenvale. She aids Alliance adventurers with woodland lore and natural magic, all while indulging her penchant for puns and jokes.
She can be found beside the Moonwell of Purity, east of Iris Lake in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is Shael'dryn's connection to Raene Wolfrunner?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner directs adventurers to Shael'dryn because the dryad possesses the spiritual knowledge necessary to investigate and cleanse corrupted gems and relics recovered throughout the forest.

faq.q: What is unique about Shael'dryn's appearance?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn and her fellow dryad Illiyana share an uncommon coloration that sets their models apart from most other dryads encountered across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What kind of personality does she have?
faq.answer: Unlike the stern and somber tone common among many Kaldorei defenders, Shael'dryn is recognized by her peers as a lover of humor and clever wordplay, maintaining a jovial outlook despite the forest's plight.

faq.q: Is Shael'dryn friendly to the Horde?
faq.answer: No. Positioned beside the Moonwell of Purity and closely allied with the Astranaar Sentinels, Shael'dryn is hostile toward members of the Horde.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, Shael'dryn is a welcome sister of the forest whose natural ties to Cenarius make her indispensable for cleansing tainted woodland relics.
Druids will appreciate her natural connection to the spirits of Kalimdor and her insight into restoring flora and fauna warped by dark powers.
The Moonwell of Purity serves as a sanctuary in Ashenvale, where Shael'dryn assists Alliance forces resisting corruption and hostile encroachment.
